card.title: For the Record
card.instruction: Get someone to state exactly what they did, knew, or authorized before you reveal your own involvement.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before I show you the fireworks invoice, exactly what did you approve?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Did you buy the enormous rocket?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: First, did your 'make it memorable' include rockets?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It included sparklers. Nothing that needed a trailer.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: When did you first mention the trailer limit? I need that date before we get to the delivery date.

mechanism: A insists on B's exact authorization and timing before disclosing A's own fireworks purchase and delivery.
confusable: Unlike neutral fact gathering, A makes B's statement a prerequisite to revealing implicated personal evidence.
comparison: Trailer scope and date define the fireworks record; the dinner scene compares authorization and invitation timestamps.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
